ns2:course.label: Professional Stage Management
ns2:course.description: In depth review of principles, techniques and practices related to professional stage management. Each semester will explore a different aspect of stage management and live performance through a series of readings, activities and class discussions. May be repeated once per semester for all BFA Stage Management students. Prerequisite: BFA Stage Management Majors Only.
